title: Frosted copy, a lightbox and a print
label: Print bench: a ruled, dot-gridded lit bed holds a pane, its dashed blur reach and a halftone frost spilling past it; a two-bar carriage, paper rolls in forked brackets, and a ledge with a histogram and blur dial.
caption: Drag ← → to set the blur. Frost is a blurred copy of what sits behind the pane, sampled at half resolution: widen the blur and the halftone sample spreads past the pane, its dashed reach grows, the carriage opens and the histogram flattens.
